rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a computer file or an organized file of papers.

example.english: This file is saved on the company computer.
example.traditional: 呢個檔案放咗喺公司部電腦度。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dong2 on3 fong3 zo2 hai2 gung1 si1 bou6 din6 nou5 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a computer file understood specifically as a document, rather than arbitrary stored data.

example.english: Please open the file again for me to take a look.
example.traditional: 請你開返份文件畀我睇吓。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 hoi1 faan1 fan6 man6 gin6 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5

rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to submit official documents to an office.

example.english: Remember to file the documents with the office tomorrow.
example.traditional: 你記住聽日要交文件畀辦公室。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 zyu6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 man4 gin6 bei2 baan6 gung1 sat1

rows.note: Use this when physically smoothing, grinding, or cutting material with a file.

example.english: I use a file to smooth the edge of the wooden board.
example.traditional: 我用銼磨平塊木板個邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 co3 mo4 ping4 faai3 muk6 baan2 go3 bin1

rows.note: Use this when people enter one after another in an orderly line.

example.english: When entering the venue, everyone should file in one by one, so don't push.
example.traditional: 入場嗰陣，大家排隊入去，唔好推。
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 go2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 paai4 deoi6 jap6 heoi3 m4 hou2 teoi1

rows.note: Use this specifically when a journalist or writer submits an article or manuscript.

example.english: I need to file my article with the newspaper today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gou2 bei2 bou3 gun2

rows.note: This is the ordinary name for the hand tool used to remove material and smooth or shape metal.

example.english: This file is good for smoothing metal edges.
example.traditional: 呢把銼用嚟磨平啲鐵邊。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 co3 jung6 lei4 mo4 ping4 di1 tit3 bin1
